issue: Tenant paid a security deposit and the landlord has not refunded it after the premises were vacated

applicable_sections.act: Tamil Nadu Regulation of Rights and Responsibilities of Landlords and Tenants Act, 2017
applicable_sections.title: Security deposit
applicable_sections.text_summary: The security deposit is to be refunded to the tenant within one month after vacation of the premises, after making due deduction of any liability of the tenant.

confidence_flags.deposit_paid: Confirm that the tenant actually paid a security deposit.
confidence_flags.premises_vacated: Confirm that the tenant has vacated the premises.
confidence_flags.deposit_returned: Confirm whether the deposit has been refunded in full.

notes: This rule is specifically based on Tamil Nadu law. Do not apply Section 11 of the Tamil Nadu Act automatically to tenants in other States. For other jurisdictions, identify the applicable State tenancy/rent law before mapping the issue.
